reference_spoken: First Peter, chapter five, verse seven.
verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verse_spoken: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning with a heart that feels heavy and restless.
You know every worry I carry, even the ones I cannot put into words.
Right now, I choose to cast all my cares upon you, because you care for me.
Quiet the racing thoughts in my mind and calm the fear in my chest.
Where I keep imagining the worst, remind me that you are already in my tomorrow.
Teach me to breathe slowly, and to bring each worry to you as it comes.
Fill me with your peace, the peace that passes all understanding.
Help me take today one step at a time, holding tightly to your hand.
Comfort everyone praying with me who feels anxious and alone today.
